query: SELECT 'location' AS object_type, location.id, location.name AS label FROM "group" JOIN location ON location.id = "group".location_id WHERE "group".id = ?1 UNION ALL SELECT 'character', character.id, character.name FROM character_group JOIN character ON character.id = character_group.character_id WHERE character_group.group_id = ?1 ORDER BY object_type, id
